name: Balance Changes
description: With this many mods, the same item often has several recipes.

pages.title: Balance Changes
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Recipe routes that gave far more for less work were cut or toned down
- A better yield is fine if it costs a bigger build
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Steel** needs heat; **bronze** only comes from Alloyed's mixer
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() TFMG engines and Blaze Burners pollute

With this many mods, the same item often has several recipes. Where one route gave far more for less work, it was cut or toned down so the Create machine route stays worth building. A better yield is fine when it costs a bigger build.

pages.title: Metals
pages.text:
- Steel needs heat: Create Nuclear's mix is [#](2E5AAC)[heated](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() now, and the Alloy Forge no longer makes steel or bronze.
- Bronze comes from [#](2E5AAC)[Alloyed](entry://industry/alloyed)[#]()'s mixer recipe only.
- BetterEnd's smelter no longer turns 2 debris into 3 scrap.

- Debris deposits need a Netherite Drill, lava and 2,048 [#](2E5AAC)[SU](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]().
- Crushing Limestone gives TFMG Limesand. Crush cut or polished Limestone for Nuclear's Nitrate. Raw copper and zinc crush as in plain Create.

pages.title: Parts
pages.text:
- Steel plates come from TFMG's 3-press Heavy Plate.
- Ion vector thrusters must be assembled, not converted.
- Copper wire comes from the Rolling Mill, not the stonecutter.
- [#](7A3C9A)[Copycat](entry://glossary/copycat)[#]() Wings stonecut 1 to 1.

pages.title: Food
pages.text:
- The composter no longer triples dough.
- Milling wheat kernels gives about 1.25 flour each.
- Popsicle molds take 250 [#](7A3C9A)[mB](entry://glossary/mb)[#]() of melon juice.
- Mixed tomato sauce takes 2 tomatoes per 250 mB.

- Blaze powder can't be stretched with pepper powder.
- Channeling a sponge gives exactly one wet sponge.
- Garnished stone slabs don't stonecut back into blocks or crush for ore.

pages.title: Bees and drills
pages.text:
- [#](2E5AAC)[Bees](entry://food/bees)[#]() can't make alloys, rose quartz, rare metals (titanium, tungsten, platinum, uranium, mithril, netherite), sulfur, saltpeter or rare mob drops.
- Deposit drills mine gems and glowstone at [#](2E5AAC)[Ore Excavation](entry://industry/ore_excavation)[#]()'s own speed.

pages.title: Other
pages.text:
- No Uncrafting Table reversing.
- Propulsion burners don't heat mixers or superheat.
- TFMG engines pollute while running, and Blaze Burners while they burn fuel. See [#](2E5AAC)[Pollution](entry://survival/pollution)[#]().
- Melon juice and cider hydrate like water.

- Ferrets dig emeralds, not totems.
- Granite gives uranium 10%% of the time.
- A Biomass Pellet takes 2 Biomass.
- Mana Siphon never makes netherite.
